tasks.label: neurosync-backend
tasks.command: $env:Path = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','Machine') + ';' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','User'); cd backend; python -m pip install -r requirements.txt; python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000

tasks.label: neurosync-frontend
tasks.command: $env:Path = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','Machine') + ';' + [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path','User'); cd frontend; npm install; npm run dev

tasks.label: install-python-node
tasks.command: winget install -e --id Python.Python.3.11 --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements; winget install -e --id OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements
